metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.1 · 2003 · Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.4 · 2006 · Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
metas.description: Jack Sparrow races to recover the heart of Davy Jones to avoid enslaving his soul to Jones' service, as other friends and foes seek the heart for their own agenda as well.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.2 · 2007 · Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
metas.description: Will Turner, Elizabeth Swann, Hector Barbossa, and the crew of the Black Pearl try and rescue Jack from Davy Jones's locker, and prepare to fight Lord Cutler Beckett, who controls Davy Jones and the Flying Dutchman.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.6 · 2011 · Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
metas.description: Jack Sparrow and Barbossa embark on a quest to find the elusive fountain of youth, only to discover that Blackbeard and his daughter are after it too.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.5 · 2017 · Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
metas.description: Captain Jack Sparrow searches for the Trident of Poseidon to rule the sea while being pursued by old rival Captain Salazar and a crew of deadly ghosts who have escaped from the Devil's Triangle.
